subject: Trading
title: Who Trades Forex?
description: Learn Who Trades Forex? in one minute.

hook.text: Goldman Sachs, Toyota, a tourist at the airport—they're all forex traders, just at wildly different scales.

buildup.text: Banks trade for profit and liquidity. Corporations hedge currency risk on international revenue.

discovery.text: Central banks intervene to stabilize or weaken their currencies. Hedge funds speculate on macro trends.

twist.text: Retail traders—individuals with online accounts—make up less than 5% of daily forex volume.

climax.text: Forex is dominated by institutions. Retail traders are small fish in the biggest ocean in finance.

punchline.text: You're trading against giants. Know your size.

quiz.question: What percentage of daily forex volume comes from retail traders?
